programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Host Wil Willis tests the Garand against the Arisaka Type 99, showcasing its impact in WWII and sniper rifles' deadly precision, from Carlos Hathcock to Craig Harrison. Witness the historic rifles that shaped warfare!

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5
programme.desc: Episode 2 begins after the desperate German winter of 1941. Yet 1942 began badly for the Soviets, with more vicious Nazi campaigning seeing millions more Russians captured and starved.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The IRA Conspiracy
programme.desc: During WWII, the IRA's "S Plan" aimed to bomb Britain, drawing German support to weaken the British. "Operation Green" and "Plan Kathleen" envisioned IRA aiding a German invasion of Northern Ireland, but both failed due to bungling and infighting.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: Operation Galia
programme.desc: Monty’s journey sees him follow the path 33 SAS soldiers took after they were parachuted behind enemy lines to attack the enemy and create chaos to draw Nazi-fascist forces away from the front line.

programme.title: Secret War: The French Triple Agent
programme.desc: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: I et kappløp med tiden krysset over åtte hundre private båter Den engelske kanal for å redde de havarerte soldatene fra infernoet på strendene ved Dunkerque. Se de enkelte veteranenes ekstraordinære heltemot i et slag som endret andre verdenskrigs forløp.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due
programme.desc: During WWII, Greek Prime Ministers Tsolakoglou, Logothetopoulos, and Rallis collaborated with Nazi occupiers, imposing fees that caused a famine.

programme.title: Hitler's Mega Plane
programme.desc: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”, the biggest aircraft in WWII.

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS stands for terror and the murder of millions. Documentary about the history of a symbol that represents murder.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.
programme.sub-title: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Croatian Collaborator
programme.desc: Croatia grapples with its fascist past through figures like Dinko Sakic, once hailed as a hero but later convicted of war crimes. Leading the notorious Jasenovac camp, Sakic oversaw brutal atrocities against inmates.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Artillery, "The King of Battle," has shaped history from ancient cannons to today's M777 Howitzer. Host Wil Willis visits Fort Sill, Oklahoma, to witness modern artillery like the M777 and M109 Paladin in action.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Plas Teg
programme.desc: The county of Flintshire in Wales is said to be a land filled with ghosts and haunts. Plas Teg is said to be one of the "most haunted" houses in the area. With over 400 years of history, this place is sure to be the home of many an entity.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Bulkeley Hotel
programme.desc: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Weir Mill and the search for paranormal activity takes a darker turn. Will they finally uncover the truth behind the buildings dark hauntings?

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mill, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A winding system of caves makes Kentucky one of the most unique geological wonders in the world. Near the caves is Bethlehem Academy, a long-abandoned Catholic School that is being kept alive by a unique resident.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: For nearly 200 years, the Jailer’s Inn housed prisoners, many of whom were involved in the city’s bustling Bourbon trade. The Team visits with the Inn’s manager to learn about notable inmates like Jesse James.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team journeys to Bardstown, KY which is hailed as “the oldest Western stagecoach stop in America” and a prominent location for the state’s famed bourbon trail and home to the infamous Talbott Tavern.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team meets with author David Domine to learn about the tragedy of Annie Whipple, a supposed “witch” who communicated with spirits to save the life of a child in her care.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Joe Pantoliano
programme.desc: Joe Pantoliano (The Sopranos, Matrix) returns to the site of the paranormal experience he and his girlfriend had at a hotel in Sante Fe, New Mexico.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Dot Jones
programme.desc: Dot Jones (Glee, Nip Tuck) has been haunted by paranormal experiences that began in her childhood home. Dot seeks Psychic Medium, Kim Russo's help.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Wayne Newton
programme.desc: Wayne Newtown (Mr. Las Vegas) revisits the theatre in Las Vegas, NV where he encountered the ghost of his famous friend. Psychic medium Kim Russo is unable to hold back her own emotions as she prepares for this journey with Wayne.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Brett Cullen
programme.desc: Brett Cullen (The Dark Knight Rises, Devious Maids and Revenge) returns to his former residence in Richmond, VA where he and his family encountered traumatic paranormal events.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Enrico Colantoni, Lisa Lisa, Bernie Kopell, Heather McDonald
programme.desc: After moving into an old country house, Enrico has a series of horrifying encounters that make him realize he's not the only one residing in the home.
programme.sub-title: Enrico Colantoni, Lisa Lisa, Bernie Kopell, Heather McDonald

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Patricia Velasquez, Susie Essman, Elya Baskin
programme.desc: Patricia is terrorized by a ghost who escapes from the pages of an antique book. Susie feels she has made the biggest mistake of her life but finds forgiveness and unconditional love from the spirit of her grandmother.
programme.sub-title: Patricia Velasquez, Susie Essman, Elya Baskin

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Jackee Harry, Louie Anderson, Angie Stone, Richard Burgi
programme.desc: A malicious child predator enters Jackee's home and she is rescued by her guardian angel. After a performance, Louie Anderson is visited by the ghost of his mother who had suddenly passed.
programme.sub-title: Jackee Harry, Louie Anderson, Angie Stone, Richard Burgi

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Tracy Scoggins, Fairuza Balk, Della Reese, Patrick Muldoon

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A high school student develops an ability after injecting promicin. Tom visits Isabelle in jail, while Diana searches for her missing sister. Following the advice of a young woman named Cassie, Kyle is able to wake Shawn from his coma.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for a person who has the ability to make people's worst fears come to life. Danny seeks Shawn's help in finding a promicin shot. Cassie leads Kyle to a book that contains a prophecy about Jordan Collier.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Audrey Parker develops the ability to astral project herself. However, after she is murdered, Audrey attempts to use her ability to lead Tom and Diana to her killer.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: April's new ability endangers her life. Shawn is approached to run for public office, while Kyle helps Isabelle.
programme.sub-title: The Truth And Nothing But The Truth

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: After realizing Tom knows he is promicin-positive, Kyle joins Jordan in a remote town called Evanston. Tom follows Kyle, and learns the remarkable truth about Evanston: all of its residents are promicin-positive.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for Curtis Peck, a 4400 film maker whose ability allows him to `know` the truth behind historical conspiracies. Jordan tries to recruit Shawn into his movement.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Jordan and his followers annex a run-down part of Seattle, dubbing it `Promise City`. Shawn's campaign for city council is threatened when a woman accuses him of using his healing ability in exchange for sex.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A lockdown at NTAC threatens the lives of Tom, Diana, Meghan, Shawn, Kyle, Jordan, Isabelle, Maia, Marco, PJ and Brady when they wakeup inside the building with no recollection of how they got there.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Richard kidnaps Isabelle from Collier's Promise City. Richard hopes to start a new life with his daughter. Elsewhere, Tess has taken over a 1950's diner, and Shawn is asked to intervene.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The Director of National Intelligence pressures NTAC to pursue Richard and Isabelle. Richard is visited by his dead wife, Lily.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A computer virus attacks a large software company owned by a suspected member of The Marked. Maia visits Promise City and receives an unexpected birthday gift.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Isabelle works with Tom in order to get close to Jordan. Shawn recruits a small band of promicin positives to break Kevin out of Promise City. Tom and Diana face off in the backroom of a grocery store, and Diana is forced to shoot Tom.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Danny Farrell's newfound ability to spread promicin leads to several hundred deaths, including his mother. With Seattle in chaos, NTAC is forced to accept Promise City's offer of help.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A comet is due to pass by Earth, but its trajectory changes to a collision course, causing widespread panic. When the comet appears to slow down - as if it's coming in for a landing - 4,400 people are deposited in an explosion over Highland Beach.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 returnees have been missing from months to years. None have any memory of where they've been, none have aged, and a small number are beginning to manifest paranormal abilities. Tom Baldwin and Diana Skouris are appointed to investigate.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: 3 months after freeing Santanico from the Titty Twister, the Gecko Brothers are still on the run. Seth & Kate are lost in Mexico while Richie & Santanico plot vengeance on the culebra Lord.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Seth & Kate pull off a heist, while Ranger Freddie Gonzalez confronts visions that lead to a discovery. Back at the Twister, Carlos's emergence from the Labyrinth sets plans into motion.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Richie & Santanico pose as sex traffickers to infiltrate Malvado's food supply. Sonja forces Seth to kick a habit. Freddie faces Sex Machine, who attacks his family to retrieve the codex.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: Humanoids From The Deep
programme.desc: Scientific experiments backfire and produce horrific mutations: half man, half fish, which terrorize a small fishing village by killing the men and raping the women.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Genetic Genealogy Cracks 53 Year Old Mystery in 2025

programme.sub-title: Genetic Genealogy Cracks 53 Year Old Mystery in 2025

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Apartment That Keeps a Secret: What Happened to Anne Manchester?

programme.sub-title: The Apartment That Keeps a Secret: What Happened to Anne Manchester?

programme.sub-title: SOLVED: Teen TRICKED Her Kidnapper and ESCAPED Captivity! The Incredible Survival of Abby Hernandez

programme.title: Gabulosis: Weld County Jane Doe: She Waited 51 Years to Be Named

programme.sub-title: Weld County Jane Doe: She Waited 51 Years to Be Named

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1967, 75-year-old widow Louisa Dunne was raped and strangled in her Bristol home. The case remained unsolved for 57 years until DNA evidence led to the 2025 conviction of 92-year-old Ryland Headley.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Canada's Oldest Investigation Solved By Genetic Genealogy
programme.desc: In June 2006, construction workers in Sutherland, Saskatoon, Canada uncovered the remains of an unidentified woman from the early 1900s. Her name and story remained a mystery for another 19 years.
programme.sub-title: Canada's Oldest Investigation Solved By Genetic Genealogy

programme.title: Gabulosis: Florida’s Oldest Missing Child Case That Still Has No Answers: The Puzzling Case of "Jon Jon" Hagans

programme.sub-title: Florida’s Oldest Missing Child Case That Still Has No Answers: The Puzzling Case of "Jon Jon" Hagans

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A man meets a woman on Facebook who says she needs help. Hours later, his throat is slashed and he's thrown off a bridge into a river. Against all odds, he survived. A solved true crime case that is savage, predatory, and an incredible story of survival.
programme.sub-title: She used Facebook to Lure him in... Then she Slit his Throat & Threw him off a Bridge

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime

programme.sub-title: Teen Thought Dramatic 911 Call Could Fool Cops... But She Forgot One Thing

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.desc: En vetenskapsman från det ursprungliga samväldet dyker upp, fångad i en tidsloop.

programme.title: Andromeda: Försök med screed
programme.desc: Flavin återvänder och utlöser ett gängkrig och hjälper Dylan att utvecklas som Paradine.

programme.title: Andromeda: Så bränn de otämnda länderna
programme.desc: En kristall som kan återställa Andromedas kraft upptäcks, men för att få tag på den måste Dylan arbeta för gruvans ägare.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det som kommer att bli var inte
programme.desc: Tunnlar upptäcks på Seefra som kan användas för att nå åtta andra Seefra-planeter.
programme.sub-title: Det som kommer att bli var inte

programme.title: Andromeda: Testet
programme.desc: När en gammal man mördas är Beka, Rhade och Harper huvudmisstänkta och ställs inför rättegång.

programme.title: Andromeda: Genom ett mörkt glas
programme.desc: Rhade leder rebellerna i strid mot en krigsherre på Seefra-5.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stolthet före det fall
programme.desc: Dylan upptäcker att Bekkas pojkvän egentligen var Drago Musevini och att han använde Bekkas DNA för att skapa Nietzscheanerna.

programme.title: Andromeda: Månskenet blir till dig
programme.desc: Beka och Rhade hittar ett prov som antingen kommer att ge dem stora rikedomar eller driva dem till vansinne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det förflutna är prolix
programme.desc: Harper upptäcker ett program som kan förstöra åtta av Seefras planeter och döda miljontals människor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traffic Violations
programme.desc: The body of a young woman was found a mile from her abandoned car. Police were especially concerned when they realized the victim had come to them for protection just two weeks earlier after a road rage incident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: In 1969, 25-year-old phone operator Diane Maxwell was raped and murdered. Her brother promised he'd find out who was responsible and bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Disrobed
programme.desc: The crime scene was especially violent: a husband and wife had been shot to death in their bedroom. Was their 16-year-old daughter complicit?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Driven to Silence
programme.desc: A young hairdresser was sexually assaulted and murdered in her own beauty salon. The evidence at the crime scene didn't match any of the suspects and, after the initial investigation, the case went cold for ten years.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Printed Proof
programme.desc: When two women went missing and were later found brutally murdered, police wondered if they were victims of a hate crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: About Face
programme.desc: A human skeleton was discovered in the North Carolina marshlands. When investigators learned she'd been dead for 18 months, they knew it would be difficult to find out who she was, let alone who killed her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In the Bag
programme.desc: After shooting his victims in the head, the killer staged the scene, placed the incriminating evidence into a plastic bag and tossed it into the river.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Yes, In Deed
programme.desc: It was a tragic twist of fate. Just days after a woman sold her home and moved to a modest trailer, a fire took both the trailer and her life. But the autopsy proved this was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Guarded Secrets
programme.desc: A security guard disappeared from his post without a trace; his remains were found a year later in a remote campsite.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Assets
programme.desc: In 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery was found brutally murdered at her Illinois business. Investigators had to determine if this was a robbery gone wrong or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Hunting
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoot to Thrill
programme.desc: In 2003, St. Cloud teenager Jason MacLennan returned home after a night out with friends and discovered his father's body lying in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Political Thriller
programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Cross
programme.desc: In 1996, Virginia Beach police arrive at the Makdessi apartment to find the bloodied bodies of Elise Makdessi and Navy sailor Quincy Brown. But was Brown Elise's lover or her assailant?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dancing with the Devil
programme.desc: In 1999, Patrick McRae was found dead in his Des Moines home and the crime scene was awash with blood. Analysis showed it had come from two people, one of whom was female.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police

programme.desc: Audrina försöker komma över Justin genom att haka upp med Brody när flickorna krascha pojkarnas surfa resa till Hawaii. Heidis jungfru ex-pojkvän kommer på besök och hon hoppas några av hans värderingar kommer att smitta av sig på Spencer.
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush

programme.title: The Hills: Playmates Bring the Drama
programme.desc: Audrinas hjärta krossas när Brodys flickvän konfronterar henne med frågor om Hawaii och Brody gör ingenting för att stoppa henne. Heidi läser ett sms från Stacie till Spencer och drar till en nattklubb för att konfrontera henne.

programme.title: The Hills: Keep Your Enemies Closer
programme.desc: Justin konfronterar Audrina om att hon strulade med Brody på Hawaii. Stephanie förstör en fotografering på jobbet och Lauren ställs till svars inför Kelly. Bartendern Stacie försöker att bli sams med Heidi.

programme.title: The Hills: Father of The Bride
programme.desc: Spencer försöker att rädda förhållandet med Heidi genom att be hennes far om hennes hand. Lauren tvingas att avskeda Stephanie från People's Revolution - vilket riskerar att förstöra deras vänskap.

programme.title: The Hills: Hi Lauren, It's Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren är tveksam om hon ska gå på Heidis bröllop efter det att Spencer äntligen bett om ursäkt. Brody vägrar att riskera vänskapen med Jayde för att rädda förhållandet med Audrina - och Stephanie konfronterar Kelly Cutrone.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Old, Something New
programme.desc: I Laurens sista avsnitt måste hon bestämma sig för om hon kan förlåta Spencer och stötta Heidi på hennes prinsessbröllop. Alla är där - och blir chockerade när en oväntad gäst dyker upp.

programme.title: The Hills: It's On Bitch
programme.desc: Kristin startar krig när hon flörtar med Justin framför näsan på Audrina. Trots att de letar ny bostad tillsammans köper Spencer en utan att Heidi godkänt det.

programme.title: The Hills: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.desc: Efter att Audrina struntat i henne, beslutar sig Kristin för att inte kämpa emot att hon är så attraherad av Justin. Heidi erbjuder sig att sitta barnvakt åt grannen, men Spencer vill inte ha nåt med barn att göra.
programme.sub-title: Mess With Me, I Mess With You

programme.title: The Hills: Strike One
programme.desc: Kristin får känna på hur det är att vara i ett förhållande med Justin när han aldrig dyker upp på Brodys överraskningsfest. Heidi och Spencer är inte överens om när de ska skaffa barn, och Audrina går på dejt med Justins bäste vän.

programme.title: The Hills: Old Habits Die Hard
programme.desc: Kristin tror att hon har tämjt Justin, men han har kanske inte kommit över Audrina än. När Holly ballar ur på ett event så tvingas Heidi ta upp hennes alkoholproblem med sin syster.

programme.title: The Hills: Sorry Boo, Strike Two
programme.desc: Justin spelar svårfångad med Kristin, men hans plan går i stöpet. Hollys supande gör att Heidi och Stephanie ordnar en intervention. Brody och Jayde börjar slåss och tvingas tänka över sin vänskap.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Justin hamnar på hal is efter det att Kristin och Audrina till slut träffats. Det enda Heidi vill ha i födelsedagspresent är en bebis, men Spencer har siktet inställt på nåt helt annat.

programme.title: The Hills: On To The Next
programme.desc: Kristin och Brody funderar på att börja dejta igen, men när de träffar Jayde inser de att tidpunkten är fel. Audrina och Justin diskuterar sin framtid, men det slutar inte som hon hoppats. Spencer tar till drastiska metoder mot Heidis bebisdrömmar.

programme.title: The Hills: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.desc: Kristin och Jayde hamnar i bråk när hon försöker att få tillbaka Brody. Heidi planerar att bli gravid vare sig Spencer vill det eller inte, och Audrina bearbetar det faktum att Justin fortfarande har känslor för Kristin.
programme.sub-title: Can't Always Get What You Want

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. Right Now
programme.desc: Kristin vill inte bli ihop med Justin, men han ger sig inte utan kamp och Audrina gör slut med Justin för gott. Brody får kalla fötter när Jayde vill flytta in hos honom och Spencer har ångest över att Heidi kan vara gravid.

programme.title: The Hills: The Boys Of Summer
programme.desc: Kristin och Justin tar förhållandet till nästa nivå och Spencer konfronterar Heidi om gravtestet. Brody kanske fortfarande hyser känslor för Kristin efter det att Jayde talat ut om deras förhållande på en förlovningsfest.

programme.title: The Hills: Put On A Happy Face
programme.desc: Det blir inte roligt för Heidi att komma hem när mamma ogillar att hon gjort plastikkirurgi. Kristin och tjejerna åker till Miami för Super Bowl-helgen, men resan går snett när hennes festande börjar oroa Audrina, Lo och Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Rumor Has It
programme.desc: När det börjar gå rykten om Kristins festande får Stephanie skulden. Audrina börjar dejta en ny kille, men det hindrar inte Brody från att jaga henne. Spencer blir upprörd när han springer på Stephanie på Kristins fest.

programme.title: The Hills: The Elephant In The Room
programme.desc: Heidi har fest för sin granne, men festen hamnar i skymundan när Spencer blir arg på Holly. Kristin tycker att Audrina ska vara med Ryan och försöker sen komma närmare Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: This Is Goodbye
programme.desc: Heidis och Spencers beteende tvingar deras vänner och familjer att göra ett svårt val. Kristin och Brody får ihop det, men båda vill hellre vara singel. Ryan gör Audrina besviken när han aldrig dyker upp trots att de ska gå ut.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Bird
programme.desc: Brody riskerar sin vänskap med Kristin när han börjar gå ut med en ny tjej. Lo ordnar en dubbeldejt åt Stephanie. Ryan ger Audrinas vänner en ny chans.

programme.title: The Hills: Ghost From The Past
programme.desc: Kristin har svårt att gå vidare från Brody. Audrina råkar på Justin och börjar tveka över sitt förhållande med Ryan. Lo slår upp en bekantskap med Brodys nya flickvän.

programme.title: The Hills: The Company You Keep
programme.desc: Brodys nya kärlek gör Kristin till sin fiende när hon tar med en gammal rival till Kristins fest. Ryan kommer hem från turnén, men Audrina berättar inte att hon träffade Justin medan han var bortrest.

programme.title: The Hills: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place
programme.desc: Audrinas förhållande med Ryan sätts på prov när han träffar Justin för första gången. Brody tar Kristins parti när Aliie börjar bråka med henne. Stephanie går på en andra dejt, men den är en besvikelse.
programme.sub-title: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place

programme.title: The Hills: Break-Up to Make-Up
programme.desc: I samma veva som Audrina gör slut med Ryan överraskar Justin henne på födelsedagen. McKaelas vän Allie ställer till mer bråk för Kristin. Brody säger ett sanningens ord till Justin.

programme.title: The Hills: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: När hela gruppen åker till Costa Rica för att surfa gör blir Brody svartsjuk när Kristin får ihop det med en bartender. Audrina försöker förneka sin attraktion till Justin, och Stephanie passar inte in i djungelmiljön.

programme.title: The Hills: Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Kristin och Brody talar ut och hon berättar att hon vill att de försöker på nytt. Heidis mamma besöker LA i hopp om en återförening. Lo och hennes pojkvän firar årsdag, och Stephanie börjar dejta en ny kille.

programme.title: The Hills: All Good Things...
programme.desc: Kristin står inför ett stort beslut som även påverkar Brody. Audrina gör slut med Justin. Lo vet inte om hon är redo för nästa steg med sin pojkvän och Stephanie tror att hon äntligen funnit den rätte.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Hold Grudges... JK!
programme.desc: En nystart för detta kompisgäng när de återvänder till The Hills och träffar varann för första gången på länge. De ställs inför nya utmaningar, men gamla rivaliteter och romanser ställer till det. Ibland är det förflutna inte förflutet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Exes Haunt These Fields
programme.desc: Ett ex kommer vid värsta tänkbara tidpunkt och förstör en spirande romans mellan en singel och ett annat ex. Det hettar till mellan Mark och Aubrey. Billy har känslor för Lexi. En dyrkdejt delas ut.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Coffey Run
programme.desc: Cameron får står till svars för brott mot sina ex. Mark och Aubrey får ta itu med ett oväntat ex. Ett ex får åka hem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Want It That Way
programme.desc: Aubrey vill både äta kakan och ha den kvar när det gäller Mark och Coffey. Cameron kan inte låta Ariana gå vidare. Cirkusen är i stan och en dyrkdejt delas ut.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Roses Are Red, Exes Make You Blue
programme.desc: Mechies spirande kärlek prövas när ett nytt ex anländer. Vid en överraskande ceremoni blir singlarna varse att deras agerande får konsekvenser. Ett hemligt förhållande blir avslöjat.
programme.sub-title: Roses Are Red, Exes Make You Blue

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Thruple Trouble
programme.desc: Aubreys och Marks förhållande slår i botten. Devins nya romans gör att Marie flippar ur. Sista crushdejten utses och en oväntad gäst avbryter

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Two for One Deal
programme.desc: Coffey befinner sig mitt i Marks och Aubreys uppbrott. Mechie slits mellan sitt ex och sin nya kärlek vilket får Ariana att sitta på helspänn. Två ex skickas hem i dissceremonin.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Show Me the Receipts
programme.desc: En del bekanta och obekanta ansikten dyker upp för att röra om i grytan. Ett lögndetektortest tvingar vissa singlar att erkänna att de är struliga.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: The Final Crush
programme.desc: Huset måste brottas med resultatet från lögndetektortesterna. Singlarna måste fatta det ultimata beslutet. Kommer de att åka hem med exet, en ny kärlek eller ensamma?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion
programme.desc: Singlarna och exen återförenas för första gången sen den sista dyrkceremonin. Programledare är Jared Haibon och vi får veta vilka par som fortfarande är i smekmånadsstadiet, vilka som gjort slut och vilka som nu delar säng med sina ex.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Celeb Surprises
programme.desc: Åtta heta kärlekstörstande kändisar träffas i en villa. Kori ser ett bekant ansikte medan Mike tar sin kändisflört på dejt. Men det kommer fler överraskningar innan det första exet rör upp känslorna!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Love Triangle
programme.desc: Kaz och exet Theo försonas, men hur länge håller det... Kori och Sofie kommer varandra närmare innan KC lägger sig i och Nathan får en uppenbarelse!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: SOS
programme.desc: En ny kändis blir ett hot mot Sofie och Kori. Det är jobbigt för Kaz att bo med Theo. Nathan och Tommy försonas, och Hemlighålet avslöjas till KC:s stora skräck.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Secret Kisses
programme.desc: KC:s ex Michael kommer in från Hemlighålet, och alla golvas av hans ursäkt. Kori och Ella kommer varandra närmare. Theo och KC kysser varandra i hemlighet, men de får sig en överraskning.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Loose Lips
programme.desc: Michael Goonans hemliga uppdrag avslöjas i Hemlighålet, men han har svårt att hålla tungan i styr. Ett ex innebär trubbel för Kori och Ella, och KC får grönt ljus av Kaz.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: True Colours
programme.desc: Michael Goonan skickar hem en deltagare och ifrågasätter sin egen tid i villan. KC har svårt att umgås med Theo medan Kaz är i villan. Nathan tar farväl av sitt ex Tommy, men får ta emot ett annat ex på stranden.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Kori Gets the Hump
programme.desc: Lockie och Megan kysser varandra, Kori blir förvirrad av Sofies blandade signaler, och Nathan är rädd att Declan ska förledas.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Double Whammy
programme.desc: Kori och Lockie får en dubbelsmäll, och det vankas trubbel för kändisarna. Nathans osäkerhet tar över, och Mike får en överraskning!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Theo's 'Down Under' Dilemma
programme.desc: Theo blir förkrossad när Kaz lämnar, och hans relation till KC når sin kulmen. Lockie och Sofie blir ovänner, och ett nytt ex rör om!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Cherry On The Cake
programme.desc: Anya gillar Kori, men har Kori släppt taget om Sofie? En ny kändis uppmärksammas, originalgänget ställs inför ett tufft val, och en pridefest avslöjar en guldskatt vid regnbågens slut.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Going Going Gone!
programme.desc: Ett nyanlänt ex ser ut att fånga Megans uppmärksamhet. Kris bekänner sina känslor för Ella, Kori och Sofie gör upp, och Nathan ställs inför ett svårt val när en i originalgänget ska ut!

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1987 Honda CRX
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Brians Honda CRX. Det är den första bilen som får en splitterny motor, eftersom den gamla dör innan Xzibit får in den på verkstaden.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: '72 Landcruiser
programme.desc: Gaby var en nyligen dumpad yogainstruktör, som inte hade något i världen utom sin yogamatta och sin Land Cruiser från 1972. Expojkvännen sålde bilen till henne för 200 dollar. Killarna börjar jobba med utsidan...

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1989 Ford Escort
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar gänget från West Coast Customs Kerrys Ford Escort. Bilen hade svetsats och "klistrats" ihop av två separata bilar. Gänget bedömde att den var trafikfarlig...

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1984 Cadillac Eldorado
programme.desc: Xzibit takes a beat-up 1984 Cadillac Eldorado and restores it to it's former glory.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1991 Ford Escort
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit and the boys at West Coast Customs transform a '91 Ford Escort into a European luxury mobile.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1985 Suburban

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1987 Chevrolet Blazer

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1988 Acura Legend

programme.title: Are You The One?: Beer Goggles
programme.desc: Gio- och Kaylenaffären får alla på helspänn när Gio stöter på Julia och flera andra tjejer i huset. Cam och Victoria har en natt som är lättglömd.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Mammas' Boys
programme.desc: Killarna visar sina mjuka sidor när deras mammor avslöjar pinsamma detaljer. Stephen blir extremt paranoid på grund av Gios intresse för Julia. Francesca fångas i Gios klor.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Pulling Punches
programme.desc: En fest med Adam och Eva-tema leder till svartsjuka när paren blandas, En kärlekstriangel tar form och det blir bråk när John, Tyler, Stephen och Gio försöker förstå sina förvirrade hjärtan.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Great Ex-pectations
programme.desc: En pinsam utmaning får exen att börja sprida rykten. Gio och Stephen får äntligen veta sanningen om Julia.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Third Eye Blind
programme.desc: Gamla konflikter kommer upp till ytan och ett enormt bråk leder till chock och tårar. Med bara två matchningsceremonier kvar, försöker man desperat lägga upp en strategi för att vinna.

programme.title: Are You The One?: All or Nothing
programme.desc: Det är allt eller inget när den tionde och sista matchningsceremonin närmar sig. Strategin leder gruppen till att tro på vissa matchningar, men Asaf slits mellan att följa sitt hjärta eller sitt lag.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Swipe Right for Love
programme.desc: 22 singlar flyttar in i ett hus i New Orleans för att försöka hitta den rätta, få ihop 11 par och vinna 1 miljon dollar. Par blir störtkära direkt och kärlekstrianglar uppstår.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Shot Through the Heart
programme.desc: Malcolms strulande orsakar problem när han hamnar i kläm mellan Diandra och Nurys. Keith och Alexis försöker krossa varandras hjärtan genom att dejta andra personer.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love in Limbo
programme.desc: Det starkaste paret i huset får sig en avhyvling allteftersom folk börjar ifrågasätta deras band. Michael rör om i grytan genom att försöka få flera olika par att göra slut.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Bae-trayl
programme.desc: En harmlös lek leder till hjärtesorg för ett par. Frustrationerna blir allt större, med par som kärar ner sig för fort och singlar som har svårt att hitta den rätta.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Jelly AF
programme.desc: Det blir kaos i huset när Kareem får upp ögonen för Zoe, vilket leder till tårar för Alivia. Alla är på helspänn när tjejerna väljer strategi vid parceremonin.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Don't Come at Me Crazy
programme.desc: Jada blir arg när Uche konfronterar hennes flört med Clinton, två till-och-från-par är tillsammans igen, och tjejernas familjer delar med sig av pinsamma berättelser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Sinking Relation-ships
programme.desc: Nurys kan inte acceptera relationen mellan Malcolm och Diandra, och i huset råder det konflikt mellan paren som vägrar splittras och singlarna som har svårt att få kontakt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tra Cray
programme.desc: Kareem och Alexis blir pressade när Alivia och Keith tror att de kan vara ett perfekt par. Några ex kommer på besök, bland annat ett som alla redan känner.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Tale of Two Players
programme.desc: Audrey blir paranoid när hon ser Michael klicka med Geles, Malcolm får sota för sina playerfasoner, och huset börjar undersöka nya kontakter.

programme.title: Are You The One?: No Love in Nola
programme.desc: Svartsjukan är i centrum under en vild Mard Gras-fest. Geles blir huvudfienden när hon raggar på flera killar i huset. Dimitri hamnar i dålig dager hos Jada.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love by the Numbers
programme.desc: Tyler vill lämna Nicoles kompisbubbla, och Shad visar känslor. Huset präglas av hjärtesorg och svartsjuka, när alla sätter sitt hopp till Keith för en strategisk vinst.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Ceremonin väntar, och huset vill desperat få in rätt par i sanningsbåset och få fram elva perfekta par. Keith och Alexis pressar varandra över gränsen.

programme.desc: Cartman anser sig vara South Parks viktigaste matkritiker på nätet.

programme.title: South Park: Röd släde nedskjuten

programme.title: South Park: Dansar med smurfar
programme.desc: Cartman blir utnämnd till att läsa upp morgonnyheterna i högtalarna på South Park Elementary.

programme.title: South Park: Endast medlemmar
programme.desc: Den tillträdande presidenten besöker sin hemstad.

programme.title: South Park: Läskiga fisken
programme.desc: Sharon Marshs moster Flo har presenter till Shelly och Stan. Shelly får en fantastiskt stereo medan Stans present är en fisk som ser ganska läskig ut.

programme.title: South Park: Döda barn
programme.desc: Randy försöker desperat hjälpa Sharon få kontroll på känslorna, och Cartman misslyckas oväntat nog på matematikprovet.

programme.title: South Park: Banka min bäver
programme.desc: Ike hamnar i puberteten och han och Kyle glider isär. För att de ska komma varandra närmare tar Kyle med Ike för att se 'Yo Gabba Gabba!' live.

programme.title: South Park: En elefant älskar med en gris
programme.desc: Kyle anlitar dr Mephisto, som jobbar med genteknik, för att klona hans elefant och Cartmans knubbiga gris för att vinna en naturvetenskapstävling.
programme.sub-title: En elefant älskar med en gris

programme.title: South Park: Marjorine
programme.desc: Cartman är övertygad om att flickorna har en manick som kan se in i framtiden, så Butters klär ut sig till tjej för att infiltrera deras läger.

programme.title: South Park: Vad händer med landet?
programme.desc: Garrison vill bygga en mur för att hålla papperslösa invandrare borta.

programme.title: South Park: Femlingar 2000
programme.desc: Pressen följer med stort intresse en familj med femlingar som flyttar till South Park och Cartman blir vän med en av dem. Kennys mamma försöker tjäna en slant genom att föda sin egen barnkull.

programme.title: South Park: Å jösses!
programme.desc: Gerald står öga mot öga med Trolljägaren.

programme.title: South Park: Tonsilltrubbel
programme.desc: En klantigt utförd blodöverföring leder till att Cartman får AIDS. Hur långt kan han tänka sig att gå för att hitta ett botemedel?

programme.title: South Park: Strejk
programme.desc: Pojkarna anmäler Butters till ett eftermiddags-tv-program som handlar om människor med missbildningar.

programme.title: South Park: Thanksgiving på History Channel
programme.desc: När pojkarna vill lära sig allt om Thanksgiving genom att se på History Channel blir de inblandade i ett mysterium som inbegriper utomjordingar, Natalie Portman och kalkonfyllning!

programme.title: South Park: Troligtvis (Del 2)
programme.desc: Det krisar till sig för Satan och han vänder sig till Gud för råd, medan Cartman åker dit för bedrägeri. Han skickas till Mexiko som straff.

programme.title: South Park: Rektor PK:s rättvisa
programme.desc: Kyle väljer en farlig allians istället för Stans vänskap.

programme.title: South Park: Mitt framtida jag
programme.desc: Efter en enorm storm i South Park dyker en märklig naken man upp och påstår att han Stan från framtiden.

programme.title: South Park: DikinBaus Hot Dogs
programme.desc: South Park-grabbarna renoverar och öppnar en historisk restaurang i Colorado.

programme.title: South Park: Blodiga Maria
programme.desc: Stans pappa arresteras för rattfylleri. Samtidigt lockar en blödande staty av Mary i grannstaden till sig alla möjliga missanpassade individer som hoppas på att bli helade.

programme.title: South Park: Vattkoppor
programme.desc: Pojkarna skickas över till Kenny så att de ska blir smittade med vattenkoppor. När de får reda på det bestämmer de sig för att hämnas på sina föräldrar genom att hyra en prostituerad som kan ge dem herpes.

programme.title: South Park: Döden
programme.desc: Stans gamla morfar försöker få pojkarna att döda honom. Samtidigt försöker South Parks föräldrar påverka en TV-kanal att ta bort Terrance och Philip från.

programme.title: South Park: Crème Fraiche
programme.desc: Randy blir helt besatt av matkanalen, så Sharon tvingas att hitta en egen hobby.

programme.title: South Park: The Worldwide Privacy Tour
programme.desc: Kanadas prins med fru försöker skydda privatlivet i en avskild liten stad i bergen.

programme.title: South Park: Geggfolk
programme.desc: South Park översvämmas av arbetare från framtiden som tar alla jobben för lägre löner. Männen i South Park går förvånansvärt långt för att stoppa dem.

programme.title: South Park: Korns svängiga piratspökemysterium
programme.desc: Pojkarna plågas av femteklassarna och South Park översvämmas av piratspöken i det här Halloween-avsnittet.

programme.title: South Park: SHOTS!!!
programme.desc: Randy firar Tegridy Farms framgångar. Cartman vägrar ta en spruta.

programme.title: South Park: Le Petite Tourette
programme.desc: Cartman blir överlycklig när han upptäcker att han kan säga precis vad han vill genom att låtsas att han lider av Tourettes syndrom. TV är naturligtvis snart på plats.

programme.title: South Park: Krazy Kripples
programme.desc: Jimmy och Timmy tror att ett gäng som kallas The Crips är en klubb för handikappade människor och blir medlemmar.

programme.title: South Park: Lesskigt värre
programme.desc: Ms Garrison bestämmer sig för att hon är lesbisk efter att hon återigen dumpats. Pojkarna anlitar mexikanska immigranter för att göra deras läxor åt dem.

programme.title: South Park: Hur man äter med häcken
programme.desc: Cartman har slutligen gått för långt när ett spratt som inbegriper Kennys kinder leder till att han får en 'märklig propp' att gå.

programme.title: South Park: #Omtugg
programme.desc: Kyle vill spela tv-spel med sin lilllebror, men Ike vill inte längre spela med honom, så Kyle blir rädd för att nästa generation håller på att köra om honom.

programme.title: South Park: Asspen
programme.desc: När killarna åker till Aspens skidbackar för första gången stöter Stan ihop med en av byborna och blir utmanad på en skidtävling.

programme.title: South Park: Visa snoppen

programme.title: South Park: Regnskog bängskog
programme.desc: Pojkarna skickas till Costa Ricas regnskog som en del av kören Getting Gay With Kids turné.

programme.title: South Park: Kattorgie (Del 1)
programme.desc: Shelley sitter barnvakt för Cartman och bjuder in sin olämplige pojkvän att hålla henne sällskap. Samtidigt löper Cartmans katt.

programme.desc: Leah vinner ett halsband med en andeflaska och blir överraskad när priset innehåller en bonus; andarna Shimmer och Shine. Leah önskar sig en prickig elefant och de nya bästisarna får kämpa hårt för att gömma den för Leahs kompis Zac.
